cohort: Pregnant women hospitalized in the obstetric department between March 2020 and July 2021 who tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 infection.
finding: The frequency of positive antiphospholipid antibodies (aPL) was low in pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection, but aPL positive women experienced a higher rate of obstetric complications, particularly hypertensive disorders, compared to aPL negative women.
